metricDefinitions.longSuitRuns: Initially 3+ card suit; same player leads and wins it at least twice. Proxy, not causal proof of development.
metricDefinitions.lostMasters: Public master played into an opponent-won trick; includes forced plays.
metricDefinitions.avoidableTenLosses: Ten lost despite a different legal move provably securing this trick for our team; local opportunity, not proof of globally inferior play.
metricDefinitions.endgamePoints: Points captured in tricks 7 and 8 including last-trick bonus; excludes capot.
metricDefinitions.games: --games/--seeds counts independent deals, each with paired team assignments and optional seat rotations.
